skill.name: dws
skill.usageExample: 帮我查一下今天钉钉日历上的日程，把下午 3 点的会议改到 4 点，然后在项目群里发一条改动通知。

description.zh: 通过钉钉官方 dws 命令行工具操作钉钉：管理日程会议、群聊与机器人消息、待办、审批、考勤、日报周报，读写钉钉文档、云盘、在线电子表格、AI 表格和知识库，收发邮件，查询通讯录与听记纪要，还可以实时监听群成员变动、审批流转等个人事件。首次使用需要安装 dws 并完成 dws auth login 授权，企业需管理员开启 CLI 访问。
description.en: Operate DingTalk through the official dws CLI: manage calendar events, group chats and bot messages, todos, approvals, attendance and daily/weekly reports; read and write DingTalk docs, drive files, spreadsheets, AI tables and wiki; send and read mail; look up contacts and meeting minutes; and subscribe to personal events such as group membership changes and approval flows. First-time setup requires installing dws and finishing dws auth login with CLI access enabled by your organization admin.
